bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e
for c in debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 debug-ai-debug-ai-1; do
  test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' "$c")" = true
  for p in server/workflow.js server/control/real-debug-benchmark.js server/adapters/external-review.js server/adapters/external-review-quota.js server/control/invocation-compiler.js server/control/role-output-validator.js; do
    test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$c" sha256sum "/app/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  done
done
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+path,timeout=10) as response:
        return json.load(response)
assert get("/health")["ok"]
old=get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/realdebug_6cf69ffdd7f641cba693aa2e9783c9aa")
assert old["state"]=="PAUSED" and not old["active_in_process"]
with open("scripts/real-debug-corpus.json") as f:
    corpus=json.load(f)
ids=[c["id"] for c in corpus["cases"]]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==50
assert all(sum(c["level"]==l for c in corpus["cases"])==10 for l in range(1,6))
request=urllib.request.Request(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/start",data=json.dumps({"suite":"real-debug","case_ids":ids}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=20) as response:
    result=json.load(response)
    assert response.status==202 and result["total"]==50
    print("START_ACCEPTED",json.dumps(result),flush=True)
s=get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+result["benchmark_id"])
assert s["case_ids"]==ids and s["summary"]["total"]==50
print("FRESH_FIFTY_READBACK",json.dumps({k:s.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","active_in_process","current","summary")}),flush=True)
PY
